verdict: Leads surged and cost dropped — but intake pipeline needs immediate attention.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 86 leads from Meta at an average cost per lead of $20.88 — well under your $45 ceiling — and the most recent 7-day window showed a 182% jump in leads with cost per lead falling 36% at the same time, a confirmed efficiency gain. The concern is what happens after leads arrive: your intake system shows 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments booked this period, meaning leads are coming in but not moving into your pipeline. Two tools that directly address contact speed — SMS automation and voice access — are pending setup, and getting those live is the priority action this week. Once those are in place, the October scale decision will be grounded in full cost-per-case data, not just cost per lead.
